title: Premium cart layout verified
summary: Cart styling and core cart controls verified in an isolated mobile browser session.

changes.detail: Verified ivory background, refined green typography, larger image panel, category above product title, subtle card shadow, compact address styling, promotion field and pricing summary.
Favourite and removal controls sit beneath the product image; quantity controls retain 44px targets.
Sticky payment action displays quoted total; secure checkout text is used while no quote is available to avoid showing a false zero total.
Removed address/order divider for a cleaner section transition.

validation.name: Mobile TypeScript
validation.detail: npm.cmd --prefix mobile run typecheck passed after final source edits.

validation.name: Diff whitespace
validation.detail: git diff --check passed for the cart source.

validation.name: Responsive browser checks
validation.detail: Headless Edge at 320, 390, 490 and 768px: populated cart rendered without document horizontal overflow. Screenshots captured; 320px and 390px visually inspected.

validation.name: Cart interactions
validation.detail: Quantity increased and decreased with persisted state verified; favourite saved; remove dialog opened and Keep item retained the cart.

validation.name: History integrity
validation.detail: Append-only history check passed before follow-up and is rerun after append.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: Browser uses synthetic address/cart and intercepted catalogue/quote responses, including image-unavailable fallback. Native devices, actual product image rendering, live backend quote changes, promotion submission and payment submission not tested. No deployment.
